summary.text: Becca Burnfin is the Democratic candidate for the Kansas House of Representatives, District 123, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces Republican incumbent Bob Lewis.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a teacher, union leader, volunteer coach and community advocate.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Becca Burnfin said she has more than two decades of experience in public education and is pursuing a doctorate in education policy.

She said she has served on the Big Brothers Big Sisters board, helped start a youth grant program called Youth in Governance, and serves on the Kansas National Education Association board representing southwest Kansas.
She said she was named a 2016 Crystal Apple Teacher and a 2017 Kansas Exemplary Educator.
Burnfin listed fully funded public schools, fair wages and workers' rights, and rural health care and property tax relief as her campaign's key messages.
